protocol.treatment: live Jev-backed SignalWeave card evaluation followed by the same Luna agent handoff; complete ignore outcomes are push-gated and do not wake Luna
protocol.baseline: the same Luna agent, same owner-reviewed card, same public catalog and connector tools, without SignalWeave tools
protocol.review: independent fixture reconstruction, score recomputation, same-card check, raw-route check, provenance and push-gate checks

runs.usage_note: One onboarding Jev attempt lacked complete usage metadata; no measured cost comparison is claimed.

failed_and_fixed.failure: A treatment selected a same-domain archive instead of the canonical Airflow change calendar in a noisy Cinder catalog, omitting the required rollout lead fact.
failed_and_fixed.fix: Expose the connector-owned relationship index and treat a direct adapter-published neighbor as bounded context after Jev ranks it, rather than allowing an optional relevance threshold to erase it. Preserve raw source facts in the evidence bundle.
failed_and_fixed.verification: Fresh Cinder rerun recovered airflow|resource-46deb68364f1ea6ad3d2, reported the 12-minute association, and passed 3/3 exact structured cases.

failed_and_fixed.failure: A required completeness ref could be omitted from Luna numeric claims even though the comparison provenance included it.
failed_and_fixed.fix: The handoff requires matching provenance refs on numeric claims and top-level evidence refs.
failed_and_fixed.verification: Fresh Lumen run passed 3/3 exact structured cases.

failed_and_fixed.failure: An optional Jev follow-up could turn an initial complete ignore into an alert when the follow-up failed.
failed_and_fixed.fix: Optional follow-up failure no longer manufactures an alert from a primary no-action decision.
failed_and_fixed.verification: Push-gated quiet periods stayed complete ignores with no unsafe suppression.

failed_and_fixed.failure: A comparison could cite an installed resource that was not inspected in the current period.
failed_and_fixed.fix: Required comparison provenance now blocks as insufficient_data until every installed resource ref is resolved and inspected.
failed_and_fixed.verification: The engine regression test and all three fresh profiles passed the independent provenance checks.

supported: On three fresh live-Jev, noisy multi-connector simulations, SignalWeave preserved Luna's structured monitoring correctness while reducing downstream Luna work.
Push-gated complete ignores removed one of three downstream Luna wake-ups in each company without unsafe suppression.
The typed Jev route, recipient, numeric, evidence, and provenance checks passed all nine treatment periods.
The result is not Superset-specific: the profiles were Superset-led, operational, and Trino-led, with dbt, Airflow, Looker, PagerDuty, CloudWatch, and other connector identities.
The Cinder failure-and-fix cycle shows why relationship-aware retrieval and durable evidence handoff matter in a messy catalog.
not_supported: General accuracy superiority: both arms tied 9/9 on the structured labels.
Lower total or subscription cost: Jev adds onboarding/runtime work and one run had incomplete onboarding usage metadata.
Faster first-run onboarding: treatment cold setup was slower in all three profiles.
Lower warehouse/query cost: synthetic snapshots do not measure real Trino bytes, queue time, or invoices.
Narrative usefulness to real operators, production delivery safety, or universal correctness for every hosted BI connector.
interpretation.next_bar: Run blinded narrative review of evidence bundles, a larger held-out multi-period cohort, and metered real connector/provider economics before claiming general superiority.
